thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool eu-west-1 / inference-gpu-6 saturating. GPU mem at 98%, token queue x5 growth over 4m, p50 latency spiked from 120ms -> 2.3s. Autoscaler attempted 3 scaleups and failed. Investigating.
Priya (oncall-sre): I'm on it. Paging SRE lead @Santiago and runtime eng @Morgan. Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-capacity
Santiago (sre-lead): saw the alert. Priya, can you confirm which model is the top offender? Any recent rollouts in eu-west-1?
Priya (oncall-sre): top offending model shard: model:v3.9.1-serving (traffic 28%). Stacktrace of recent requests shows lots of long-context prefill patterns.
Morgan (eng-runtime): we pushed v3.9.1 to eu-west-1 ~22:40 UTC. v3.9.1 changes: default context_max increased for some routes, plus an adaptive kv-cache warmup patch. That warmup is doing aggressive prefetch for long prompts — could explain memory blowup.
Kelly (prod-ops): Customer impact check — CS reporting slow completions and some 429 throttles for org:aceai and org:scribblecloud. Latency up and some requests queued >30s.
Infra-bot: Autoscaler log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T22:47:12Z] scale_up request for pool inference-gpu-6 x2
[2026-03-15T22:47:13Z] scale_up failed: quota_exceeded (region_quota=64 gpus_used=64)
[2026-03-15T22:47:14Z] scale_up retry blocked: cooldown_lock active
```
Alex (infra): quota_exceeded — we hit reserved cap in eu-west-1. There's a burst pool but it's gated behind a manual approval window.
Priya (oncall-sre): ok, immediate mitigations: 1) throttle v3.9.1 traffic by routing 60% to v3.8 stable; 2) temporarily disable kv-cache warmup on v3.9.1; 3) open manual burst capacity request. Morgan — can you push throttles + config toggle?
Morgan (eng-runtime): doing now. Pushing runtime traffic-split via redwoodctl.
Morgan (eng-runtime): command:
```
redwoodctl traffic set --model v3.9.1 --region eu-west-1 --percent 40
redwoodctl config set --model v3.9.1 --kv-warmup false --region eu-west-1
```
Morgan (eng-runtime): applied. Watching queues.
Priya (oncall-sre): also evicting any batch jobs in low-priority pools to free GPUs. Alex, please prioritize eviction.
Alex (infra): evicting non-critical jobs: `evict-job --pool batch-inference-eu --until 23:30Z`. Started. Expect ~2 GPUs freed in ~3m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT P0: GPU capacity exhaustion in eu-west-1. Status: investigating. Notifying status page.
Aisha (customer-success): alerted ACEAI and ScribbleCloud that we're investigating; sent initial ETA 30m and told them we may pause rollout traffic. They acknowledged.
Priya (oncall-sre): queue length metric lowering from 5x -> 1.6x after traffic-split and dropping warmup. p50 latency back to ~340ms, p95 ~2.1s. But autoscaler still blocked by quota_exceeded; we still have throttling risk if wave continues.
Morgan (eng-runtime): quick note: logs show many requests with prefix tokens causing kv-cache to prefill large contexts. Example snippet from access log:
```
{"req_id":"r-9f2","len":6120,"prefill_tokens":5400,"model":"v3.9.1","route":"/chat/gpt-like"}
```
Kelly (prod-ops): customer impact update: ACEAI reports reduced failures after we throttled, but higher latency persists during peak. Still seeing ~8% 503s on heavy batches.
Santiago (sre-lead): question for infra: why did autoscaler retry get cooldown_lock? Is that a safety throttle that needs to be reset or just natural backoff?
Alex (infra): cooldown_lock is the autoscaler's distributed lock to avoid thrash. It was held because earlier scaleup attempts partially started but couldn't finish due to quota. We need to clear stale lock or let it expire (5m). I can attempt a manual unlock if we're confident that capacity will be available.
Priya (oncall-sre): don't unlock until we confirm freed GPUs from evictions or burst pool available. Risk of flip-flopping.
Morgan (eng-runtime): can we apply a local KV eviction policy for v3.9.1 to reduce memory footprint short-term? I can push a flag to evict older prefixes sooner.
Morgan (eng-runtime): applying:
```
redwoodctl config set --model v3.9.1 --kv-ttl-seconds 120 --region eu-west-1
```
Morgan (eng-runtime): applied. Observing GPU mem drop ~7% after 90s.
Priya (oncall-sre): good. Alex — status on evictions and burst approval?
Alex (infra): evicted batch jobs freed 2 GPUs. Manual burst approval still pending from cloud ops (ticket #INC-3421) — submitted 2m ago. If approved we can add +4 GPUs.
Kelly (prod-ops): recommending a soft rollback of v3.9.1 to v3.8 for routes with >4k token contexts. Morgan, can you prepare a targeted rollback? We should avoid full rollback to minimize churn.
Morgan (eng-runtime): preparing targeted route rollback now. Command:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --from v3.9.1 --to v3.8 --filter "route: /chat/* and ctx>4096" --region eu-west-1
```
Morgan (eng-runtime): started. ETA ~90s.
incident-bot: Update: status page set to INVESTIGATING. Public note: "We are investigating elevated latencies and rate limiting for generation in eu-west-1. Mitigations are in progress."
Priya (oncall-sre): monitoring post-rollback: queue length back to baseline. p95 latency dropping toward 600ms. No new 503 spikes. Autoscaler still shows quota_exceeded but cooling.
Aisha (customer-success): ACEAI says errors dropped significantly after rollback. They appreciate the heads-up. :thumbsup:
Santiago (sre-lead): great work. Plan for next 2 hours:
- Continue to monitor queues and GPU mem for 60m.
- Cloud ops to confirm burst capacity or request quota increase.
- Runtime team to ship a safer warmup patch (rate-limited) and add telemetry for prefill volume by route.
- Product to communicate to customers impacted and list mitigation steps.
Priya (oncall-sre): handoff to night oncall @Dmitri in 45m. Current status: degraded -> recovering. Please see followups assigned.
Morgan (eng-runtime): I'll open PR to make warmup rate-limited and add feature flag: `kv-warmup-rate` with default conservative values.
Alex (infra): cloud ops approved 2 GPUs burst (partial). Autoscaler still blocked until cooldown expires; manual unlock not needed now. I'll follow up with quota request.
Kelly (prod-ops): filed customer update draft; Aisha will send consolidated message in 20m after we confirm stability.
Priya (oncall-sre): adding incident notes to runbook, tagging with root cause hypothesis: aggressive kv-cache warmup + increased default context length in v3.9.1 combined with region quota hitting autoscaler -> queue buildup -> throttling.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status: monitoring. Severity downgraded to P1. Time opened 2026-03-15T22:47:12Z. Actions: traffic-split, warmup toggle, kv-ttl, targeted rollback, batch evictions.
Dmitri (night-oncall): acknowledged handoff. I'll keep watch and escalate if any regression. Posting handoff checklist:
- monitor `gpu.pool.inference-gpu-6.queue_length` > 2 triggers page
- if `autoscaler.scale_failures` > 1 escalate to infra oncall
- confirm cloud ops quota ticket #INC-3421
Priya (oncall-sre): thanks team. Closing active mitigation loop; leaving runbook with next steps. Will reopen if metrics regress. :white_check_mark:
